name: KiwiKraft Performance
description: Precision engineered motorsport components, built to win.
story: KiwiKraft Performance has been designing and manufacturing high-performance racing parts in New Zealand for over 20 years. Born from a passion for motorsport and a dedication to engineering excellence, we seek to partner with teams that share our drive for success. We believe in supporting talent and innovation in motorsport, and aim to build long-term relationships with our sponsored teams.
